title.en: Alexander and the spread of Greek thought
title.zh: 亚历山大与希腊思想的传播

subtitle.en: 343–30 BCE · a conquest that carried a philosophy
subtitle.zh: 前343–前30 · 一场带着哲学走的征服

summary.en: A thirteen-year campaign is usually told as battles. Told as ideas, it begins with a tutor in a Macedonian village and ends three centuries later with Greek-speaking cities from the Nile to the Oxus, a library that held the world's learning, Buddhas carved in Greek drapery, and the schools — Stoic, Epicurean, Sceptic — that taught a Mediterranean now too large for the polis.
summary.zh: 十三年的东征通常被讲成一连串战役。换成思想来讲，它始于马其顿乡间的一位家庭教师，终于三百年后从尼罗河到阿姆河的一串希腊语城市、一座收藏全部已知学问的图书馆、穿着希腊衣褶的佛像，以及为一个大到城邦装不下的地中海而生的学派——斯多亚、伊壁鸠鲁、怀疑派。

source: Arrian, Anabasis; Plutarch, Life of Alexander; P. Green, Alexander to Actium (1990)

text.en: Philip II hires Aristotle to teach his thirteen-year-old son. Three years in the Nymphaeum at Mieza: Homer, biology, politics, and the conviction that Greeks are to barbarians as masters to slaves — a lesson the pupil would later discard.
text.zh: 腓力二世请亚里士多德来教十三岁的儿子。米埃扎的仙女祠里三年：荷马、生物学、政治学，以及「希腊人之于蛮族如主人之于奴隶」——这一条学生后来扔掉了。

text.en: Alexander razes rebellious Thebes but spares Athens and the house of Pindar. The same year Aristotle returns to Athens and founds the Lyceum; its library and its method of collecting everything will be the model for Alexandria.
text.zh: 亚历山大夷平反叛的底比斯，却放过雅典和品达的故居。同年亚里士多德回雅典创立吕克昂，它的图书馆和「收集一切」的方法将是亚历山大里亚的范本。

text.en: First battle against the Persian satraps. Alexander sends 300 captured suits of armour to Athens inscribed 'from Alexander and the Greeks, except the Spartans' — the campaign framed as a Panhellenic revenge.
text.zh: 对波斯总督的第一仗。他把三百副缴获的铠甲送到雅典，题「亚历山大与全体希腊人所献，斯巴达人除外」——把东征包装成泛希腊的复仇。

text.en: Darius III flees the field, leaving his mother, wife and daughters. Alexander treats them as royalty. The gesture, endlessly retold, becomes the Greek ideal of the magnanimous king.
text.zh: 大流士三世弃阵而逃，留下母亲、妻子和女儿。亚历山大以王室之礼相待。这个被反复讲述的姿态成为希腊人「宽宏之王」的理想。

text.en: Seven months building a causeway to an island city. Phoenicia's trade network passes to Greek hands; its alphabet had already become Greece's three centuries earlier.
text.zh: 七个月筑堤攻岛城。腓尼基的贸易网转到希腊人手里；它的字母表三百年前就已经变成了希腊的。

text.en: He paces out a city on the Nile delta with a grid plan by Dinocrates. Within two generations Ptolemy I's Museum and Library hold half a million scrolls; Euclid, Eratosthenes, Archimedes and Herophilus work here. For six centuries this, not Athens, is where Greek thought lives.
text.zh: 他在尼罗河三角洲上丈量出一座城，狄诺克拉底设计棋盘街道。两代人之内，托勒密一世的缪斯宫与图书馆收藏五十万卷；欧几里得、埃拉托色尼、阿基米德、希罗菲卢斯在此工作。此后六百年，希腊思想的居所是这里而不是雅典。

text.en: At the oracle of Ammon in the desert he is greeted as son of Zeus. Whatever he believed, the king as god enters Greek politics here and stays for the Hellenistic and Roman worlds.
text.zh: 沙漠中的阿蒙神谕所称他为宙斯之子。无论他信不信，「神王」从此进入希腊政治，并留在了希腊化世界和罗马。

text.en: The decisive battle. The Achaemenid empire — the first to rule from the Aegean to the Indus — ends. Its roads, satrapies and tolerance of local cults will be inherited almost intact.
text.zh: 决战。阿契美尼德帝国——第一个从爱琴海统治到印度河的帝国——终结。它的驿道、行省制和对地方神祇的宽容几乎被原样继承。

text.en: He sacrifices to Marduk and orders the temple rebuilt. Babylonian astronomers' records — centuries of eclipse tables — pass to the Greeks; Hipparchus and Ptolemy will build on them.
text.zh: 他向马尔杜克献祭并下令重建神庙。巴比伦天文学家几个世纪的日月食记录传给希腊人，喜帕恰斯和托勒密将建立在它们之上。

text.en: The palaces burn — revenge for Athens in 480, or a drunken night; the sources disagree. He begins to wear Persian dress and asks Macedonians to prostrate. The philosopher Callisthenes, Aristotle's nephew, refuses, and is later executed.
text.zh: 宫殿焚毁——是为公元前480年的雅典复仇，还是酒后失控，史料不一。他开始穿波斯服饰，要求马其顿人行跪拜礼。亚里士多德的外甥、哲学家卡利斯提尼拒绝了，后被处死。

text.en: Two years of guerrilla war in Sogdiana. He marries Roxana, a Bactrian noble's daughter, and founds Alexandria Eschate, 'the farthest'. Greek cities will survive here for two centuries: Ai-Khanoum has a gymnasium, a theatre, and Delphic maxims carved in stone.
text.zh: 索格底亚那两年游击战。他娶巴克特里亚贵族之女罗克珊娜，建「最远的亚历山大里亚」。希腊城市将在此存续两百年：阿伊哈努姆有体育馆、剧场，石头上刻着德尔斐箴言。

text.en: Victory over Porus and his elephants; the army refuses to go further. At Taxila he talks with naked ascetics — the 'gymnosophists' — and takes one, Calanus, back west. Greek and Indian thought have met.
text.zh: 击败波鲁斯和他的战象；军队拒绝再往前。在呾叉始罗他与裸体苦行者——「裸智者」——对话，带了一位名叫卡拉努斯的西行。希腊与印度的思想相遇了。

text.en: Dead at 32, of fever. Asked to whom he left the empire: 'to the strongest'. His generals fight for forty years; the result is three Greek-ruled kingdoms and a common Greek — koine — spoken from Marseille to Kandahar.
text.zh: 三十二岁死于热病。问他把帝国留给谁：「给最强者。」他的将领打了四十年；结果是三个希腊人统治的王国，和一种从马赛到坎大哈通行的共同希腊语——通用语。

text.en: Zeno of Citium, a Phoenician from Cyprus, begins teaching in the Painted Stoa. Stoicism, Epicurus's Garden (306) and Pyrrho's scepticism all answer the same question: how to live well in a world too big for a city.
text.zh: 塞浦路斯的腓尼基人、季蒂昂的芝诺在画廊开始讲学。斯多亚、伊壁鸠鲁的花园（前306）和皮浪的怀疑论回答的是同一个问题：在一个大到城邦装不下的世界里如何好好活着。

text.en: Seleucus I founds his capital. The Seleucid kingdom, stretching to Bactria, plants dozens of Greek cities along the old Persian roads; Greek becomes the language of administration from Syria to Afghanistan.
text.zh: 塞琉古一世建都。延伸到巴克特里亚的塞琉古王国沿着旧波斯驿道种下几十座希腊城市；从叙利亚到阿富汗，希腊语成为行政语言。

text.en: Ashoka's edicts are carved in Greek and Aramaic at Kandahar for his Greek-speaking subjects. Buddhist missions go west to the Greek kings; the Milinda Pañha later records a Greek king, Menander, debating a Buddhist monk.
text.zh: 阿育王在坎大哈用希腊文和阿拉米文刻下敕令，给他说希腊语的臣民看。佛教使团西行至希腊诸王；后来的《弥兰陀王问经》记录了希腊国王米南德与佛教僧侣的辩论。

text.en: In the valleys where Greek kings had ruled, sculptors give the Buddha a human body for the first time: wavy hair, a toga's folds, an Apollo's face. This image travels the Silk Road to Dunhuang, Korea and Japan.
text.zh: 在希腊诸王统治过的河谷里，雕刻家第一次给了佛陀人的身体：波浪卷发、托加袍的衣褶、阿波罗的脸。这个形象沿丝路传到敦煌、朝鲜和日本。

text.en: Cleopatra dies; the last Hellenistic kingdom becomes a Roman province. But Rome's educated class thinks in Greek, its philosophy is Stoic, and when Christianity writes its scriptures it will write them in koine. The conquest ended in 323; the thought did not.
text.zh: 克娄巴特拉死，最后一个希腊化王国成为罗马行省。但罗马的知识阶层用希腊语思考，哲学是斯多亚的，基督教写经书时用的是通用希腊语。征服在前323年结束了，思想没有。
